artifacts.summary: Author-facing memo: D1-D5 as requested paper corrections, D6/D24/D25/D27 as owner decisions, each with verified paper lines and Lean counter-evidence.
Realigned the Lean tree and its documentation with the JPL paper: record re-pinned, 30 dangling anchors repaired, false docstring claims corrected, and two write-time drift guards added.

completion_data.completion_summary: Re-baselined specs/paper-definitions-of-record.md against the paper's latest wave (4213 -> 4856 lines), taking scripts/check-paper-definitions.sh from exit 1 (32 drifted, 6 unresolvable) to exit 0, and corrected every false documentation and docstring claim the research report identified across README.md, FormalSystem/README.md, 20 Lean modules, and the typst manual. Added two mechanical guards so both classes of drift are caught at write time: C14's content scan was widened from markdown to Lean docstrings (immediately surfacing seven further stale axiom-count claims no gate had ever seen), and a new C15 asserts that every paper-anchor citation in live scope resolves against the pinned record. No Lean definition, proof, or declaration changed; lake build remains clean and sorry-free at 2493 jobs, and the paper itself was never edited.

metadata.compliance_check_reason: The plan's Goals section names files, scripts and gates rather than Lean declarations: by design this plan adds no declaration, so the declaration-existence spot-check has no targets. Compliance was instead verified against the plan's own Testing & Validation gate list, all eight items of which are green.
